Option C - Sun with a charge

annotations.text:
The manifest declares the icon "any maskable", so Android is entitled to crop it to a circle covering the inner 80%. Nothing in the current icon respects that circle.

Every option below is drawn inside it - the circle specimen on each board is the crop, not a mock-up.

Four directions, drawn at the size they will actually be seen. Palette is the app’s own: #0f172a background, #facc15 accent, #34d399 for money, #60a5fa for the panel.

Pick one and I will render the 192 and 512 PNGs and swap them in.
